    # horizontal run; walls of 8s stop the ray, with path continuing at their gap.
    # Demonstrations show path is the orthogonal complement of vertical 8 bars,
    # joined by horizontal runs through open corridors.
    marker=next(((i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==2),None)
    if marker is None: return g
    r,c=marker
    # Ray from marker heads inward along row, then follows the open gaps between
    # vertical 8 columns. Infer orientation from marker: top -> path column.
    if r==0:
        # extend down marker column to lower edge; at each broken 8 row, gap itself
        # is where path enters, then travel laterally to next gap of subsequent stripe.

        gaps=[]

            target=min(gs,key=lambda j:abs(j-pos))
